statement: If n ≥ 2 follows a Juggler prefix O^a E O^{7-a} with a in {2,3,4,5,6}, then the prefix image lies at or above the EEE inverse cell (n+1)^8. In particular the five (1,3) leftovers OOOOOOEOEEE, OOOOOEOOEEE, OOOOEOOOEEE, OOOEOOOOEEE, OOEOOOOOEEE are not cycle itineraries. Proof: a hypothesized cell hit and the exact mixed +1-chain produce n^{2187} < (n+1)^{2048} (1+1/v)^E with E = 2^{a+1}·3·(3^{7-a}-2^{7-a}); this is 3^7 > 2^{11}. A leading-chain lower bound v ≥ V at the first prefix starts (37, 113, 163, 173, 241) contradicts the cell, and the bound is monotone in n. This replaces leftover 4-fudge cutoffs 1.57e9 through 3.75e12 by the exact successor cell. Lean independently excludes all five as CycleMin words and excludes the unique-rotation member OOOOOOEOEEE as a cycle itinerary (CycleMinFudge.lean). The other four have extra CycleMin-shaped 4-even rotations outside the thirty first-expanding leftovers, so their CycleItinerary claim and the EEE-cell inequalities remain human. Not a length-11 census, not the (2,2) leftovers, and not a halt theorem.
